summary: Hubilu Venture Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its Wyoming subsidiary Elata Investments, LLC entered a September 3, 2026 purchase agreement and closed September 11, 2026 on the acquisition of real property at 5717 4th Ave, Los Angeles, for $600,000 cash. The seller was Finance of America Reverse LLC; the property was vacant at purchase. The purchase is subject to a $550,000 first-position note owed by Elata to Orch(est). No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch integration risk and near-total debt financing of the purchase price.
